business_overview.one_sentence: The Group provides private higher and secondary vocational education services in mainland China, mainly through Xinhua University and Xinhua School, with two jointly operated schools pending conversion.
business_overview.revenue_model: Tuition fees and boarding fees collected from students, generally received before the relevant academic year or semester and recognized over the service period.
business_notes: 2023/2024 total full-time students: 43,841; total enrolled students: 59,114.
School of Clinical Medicine and Hongshan College were not consolidated subsidiaries as of the annual report date pending conversion.
PRC Operating Schools are controlled through structured contracts because PRC laws restrict foreign ownership in private education.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Non-cash/financing-currency related exchange loss, excluded when viewing recurring education operation cash profit.
Government grants in other income, small relative to profit.

funds_assets.business_substance: Cash at bank/on hand and demand/short-term highly liquid deposits; group location not split by parent/subsidiary/VIE.

funds_assets.item: bank time deposits in current cash and bank balances
funds_assets.business_substance: Bank time deposits included in current cash and bank balances.
Long-term bank time deposits; maturity not fully disclosed beyond non-current classification.

operating_assets.business_substance: Campuses, buildings, teaching equipment and construction in progress used for education services.
operating_assets.source: 2023 annual report consolidated statement of financial position, p.113

operating_assets.business_substance: Land use rights/leased operating assets for schools.
operating_assets.source: 2023 annual report consolidated statement of financial position, p.113

operating_assets.business_substance: Mainly prepayment/deposit including RMB200m due from Hongshan College.

investment_assets.business_substance: RMB660m prepayment for Hongshan acquisition and RMB2,165.104m advances to School of Clinical Medicine/Hongshan campus construction.

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Unsecured bank loan and related-party loan; 100% deducted for owner earnback cash analysis.

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Tuition and boarding fees received before revenue recognition; tied to education delivery obligations.
Supplier payables, accrued staff costs, student miscellaneous receipts and interest payable.

other_liabilities.source: 2023 annual report statement of financial position, p.113

years.source: 2022 annual report comparative cash flow and MD&A, pp.10,111
2023 annual report consolidated cash flow, p.116 and Notes 6,18

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Operating cash flow exceeded reported profit in 2021-2023, but distributability is discounted for PRC private-school/VIE structure, prepaid tuition obligations, RMB440.199m authorized capital commitments and disclosed intent to retain PRC earnings for expansion.

gaps: Annual report does not split cash/time deposits between listed parent, ordinary subsidiaries and VIE schools.
Annual report does not disclose restricted cash as a separate line; absence of a line item is not proof that all cash is freely distributable.
Long-term bank time deposit maturity ladder beyond non-current classification is not disclosed.
Maintenance versus growth capex is not explicitly disclosed; analysis uses recent PPE/intangible purchase cash flows as a conservative proxy and treats school investment payments separately.
